title: Block force pushes
description: Before a shell command runs, stops it if it is a `git push` with --force or -f. Exit code 2 tells Claude Code to block the call. Needs jq.
command: if jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]].*)?[[:space:]](--force|-f)([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'Blocked: force push' >&2; exit 2; fi
